body:
I couldn't find a calendar widget without huge dependencies as good as [`react-dates`](https://github.com/airbnb/react-dates) UX-wise. This is definitely the pain point of this guide. I also had trouble getting familiar with the [Baremetrics Calendar](https://github.com/Baremetrics/calendar). I can try a workaround but it probably won't be very elegant.

As for the source code in the demo, I can add a link to the zip file.
